narrative_engine.thesis: 2.32σ VWAP stretch detected, but the anti-knife-catching gate is not satisfied (price 2.32σ from VWAP but no crowding signal yet (RSI 70, funding n/a% APR, top L/S n/a)). Wait for the footprint to print exhaustion/trap/absorption or a defending wall before fading — or for the ±3σ flush.

fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
